samples.label: Business-owner voice note (Amharic)
samples.transcript: ኩባንያችን አልፋ ፉድስ ኢንተርፕራይዝ ይባላል። ከ2019 ጀምሮ እየሰራን ነው። በ2023 ሽያጭ 8 ሚሊዮን ብር ነበር፣ በ2024 ደግሞ 12 ሚሊዮን ነበር።

samples.label: Employment numbers (English)
samples.transcript: We have about 25 total employees, and 12 of them are women.

samples.label: Youth employment (English)
samples.transcript: Around 10 of our employees are between 18 and 24 years old.

samples.label: Job creation projection (English)
samples.transcript: We plan to create 35 new jobs with the new machinery.

samples.label: Market and uniqueness (English)
samples.transcript: We sell to local markets but we are also starting to export. Our products are different from competitors because we are the first to use this packaging machine in Ethiopia.

samples.label: Afaan Oromo greeting/purpose
samples.transcript: Akkam. Maqaan dhaabbata kootii Beta Textiles PLC. Daldalli keenya uffata oomishuu fi gurguruu dha.
